name: Orient Semiconductor Electronics, Limited
summary: Orient Semiconductor Electronics, Limited engages in the manufacturing, assembly, processing, and export of various integrated circuits, semiconductor components, computer motherboards, and circuit boards in Taiwan, America, Asia, and internationally. The company offers packaging and testing services, such as wire bonding packaging, such as memory card products and embedded products; wire bond packaging, including conductor frames and carrier boards; and flip chip packaging and customized design services.
